environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) A custom rule group 'corp-query-param-restrict' with a RegexPatternSet match on the 'q' query string parameter that blocks requests where the value matches pattern .*('|--|;|UNION|SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|EXEC).* with case-insensitive matching and BLOCK action at priority 1, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK mode at priority 2. The Web ACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no permissions beyond ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and logs:PutLogEvents. The Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with the task running in awsvpc networking mode within a private subnet with no public IP assignment.

config.compute: ECS Fargate 1.4.0, awsvpc, private subnet, no public IP
